implementerProof.how: Round 8 at PR head 0f5cdd8e (code 5fd0f13e; test-only: the focused-subagent case now waits for a model request that carries 'Reply with done.' and not the start message before it opens the Agent Hub). The pod was still slow: loadExtensions finished at 26.1 s of wall time and 9.0 s of CPU. I ran that case alone 6 times as committed: 5 pass, 1 fail. Then I ran it 6 more times in a copy that logs every held request just before the hub opens: 6 pass, and the log shows what the new wait matches (below).

failures.criterion: The pull request's real-binary proof passes on a slow but normal host (the tree's architect, 2026-10-27). Case: "the operator sees a refused re-claim after /new from a focused subagent view" (controller-start-omp.test.ts), round 7's flaky case.
failures.evidence: Command, as committed at 5fd0f13e: `cd packages/pi-legion && LEGION_TEST_OMP=/opt/omp/bin/omp LEGION_TEST_NATS_URL=nats://127.0.0.1:14222 bun test ./extensions/controller-start-omp.test.ts -t "focused subagent view"`, 6 runs: pass, FAIL, pass, pass, pass, pass. The failure was the same as round 7's: 'timed out waiting for the subagent's view focused', the hub showing '⟳ 1 running … 3.0s active · 0 req' and 'Agent "PregnantSilkworm" is running and cannot be revived (no reviver registered).'. Cause: the new wait matches the wrong request. A diagnostic copy logged the held requests just before alt+a, and in all 6 runs there were exactly three: the start turn (1 message, start message), the start turn after the task call (3 messages, start message), and one request with 1 message carrying 'Reply with done.' whose system prompt begins '# Task\nLabel the delegated work in …'. That third request is Oh My Pi's task-label oneshot (prompts/system/task-label.md, sent by task/label.ts generateTaskLabel). task/executor.ts fires it 'off the spawn's critical path' when the task is spawned, before the subagent's session is attached to its registry entry (sdk.ts attachSession). The subagent's own model request had not arrived in any of the 6 runs. Waiting for the label request therefore does not prove the subagent can be focused (agent-lifecycle.ts ensureLive throws 'cannot be revived' while the running ref has no session), so the case is still flaky on this host, at 1 in 6 this round.
